To book a ticket: go to the 'Book' page, pick your From and To stations, choose a payment method, and confirm. You'll get a QR-code ticket instantly! 🎫
You can cancel a ticket from the 'My Tickets' page — just click 'Cancel Ticket' on any confirmed booking, and the fare gets refunded to your wallet automatically.

responses: You can check your exact wallet balance on the 'Wallet' page — it's shown right at the top.
To recharge your wallet: go to the 'Wallet' page, enter an amount, and click 'Add Money'. Your balance updates instantly.
If you've lost something on the metro, please report it at the nearest station's help desk or through our Lost & Found page with the station and approximate time.
If this is a real emergency, please contact station staff immediately or call the Namma Metro helpline. Your safety comes first. 🚨
